name: Stability Ball Pike
steps: Assume a high plank with your hands directly under your shoulders and your shins or tops of your feet resting on a stability ball.
Brace your abs firmly and keep your legs straight and together.
Contract your abs strongly to pike your hips straight toward the ceiling while rolling the ball forward toward your hands.
Pause briefly at the top with your torso nearly vertical, then roll the ball slowly back to a flat plank.
tips: Keep your knees locked straight throughout the pike rather than tucking them under your chest.
Stop lowering at a flat plank so your lower back never sags toward the floor.
